line.comment: * DESCRIPTION: One-time registration/cleanup of Expanded 2.2 ship-name readouts.
* Called asynchronously from setup.ZH upon upgrading from 2.2 to 2.2.1.
* Include all player ships for detected virus warnings.
* Cargo names were generated only for Freighters (TS/TP) and TLs.
* Identify the same terminal color reset used by SetReadout.
* Preserve metadata created by the new helper, if present.
* Remove the closing color sequence temporarily.
* Peel terminal statuses; tolerate multiple stale suffixes from older saves.
* First test for an active detected-virus warning: ' <V:...>'.
* Cargo percentages and bars apply only to eligible freighters/TLs.
* The terminal (latest) status wins unless a virus warning was found.
* When disabled, legacy cargo must be removed immediately.
* An infected ship must not retain an old cargo status either.
